# Wise Connector for Muse

A Muse agent skill with read-only access to your Wise account: list profiles and view multi-currency balances per profile. Read-only by design — it cannot move money or change anything. Amounts are reported in major units (dollars), not cents. The Wise API is free to use with a personal API token. Draft: written from Wise's public API docs, not yet live-tested end-to-end — this listing's unverified status reflects that. No secrets in the repo.
